description: Ministry of Defence - Amendment to the List of Designated Persons under the United Nations Regulations No. 01 of 2012
reasoning: This gazette content amends the list of designated persons under the United Nations Regulations, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It involves the modification of a statutory instrument (United Nations Regulations No. 1 of 2012) and updates to a legal list of individuals subject to sanctions, falling under legal framework and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
